name: What are common issues identified during a tiny home property assessment?

mainEntity.name: What are common issues identified during a tiny home property assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common issues identified during an assessment include restrictive zoning regulations that prohibit tiny homes, lack of access to essential utilities like water or sewer, challenging terrain requiring extensive site preparation, or unsuitable soil conditions for foundations or septic systems. We also frequently find properties with difficult access for tiny home delivery or those located in areas with specific environmental concerns. Identifying these early helps in mitigating risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common issues include restrictive zoning, lack of utilities, challenging terrain, unsuitable soil, and difficult delivery access.
